{{Quote|This'll be a walk in the&hellip; uh&hellip; ''desert''. And trust me, I know desert.''"<br />"''Your confidence is admirable, Anakin. And you may be right. But the Council advised ''caution''&hellip; and when dealing with a new breed of ''landtank'', especially one of ''this'' magnitude, I have good reason to concur.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Burn the Behemoth!" />}}
The '''''Bogg Behemoth''''' was a [[Tank/Legends|landtank]] created and operated by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] known as [[Bogg]] on behalf of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ''Bogg Behemoth'' was stationed outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Thousand Thousand]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. Before the tank could attack the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] city, a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Battle of Makem Te (Clone Wars)|captured]] Bogg and destroyed the ''Bogg Behemoth''.
